name: manual_15164c
claim: Prove cross-repository behaviour with an interop probe kept outside both repositories that runs the real issuer against the real consumer with real signature verification, so the consumer repository never imports a cryptography library.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: the probe proved seven scenarios including that an issuer restored from an older snapshot is refused as a fork, without adding a dependency to the consumer.

rationale: 2026-10-19: the probe proved seven scenarios including that an issuer restored from an older snapshot is refused as a fork, without adding a dependency to the consumer.
